policy.last_change: 4 Mar 2026 (-25bp, eff. 5 Mar); held 9 Apr and 6 May

policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 20 May close (1x4 3.87, 3x6 4.02, 6x9 4.40, 9x12 4.70 vs WIBOR 3M 3.85) price roughly 85bp of NBP hikes within 12 months. The MPC held at 3.75% on 6 May (core probably rose in April; wait-and-see); Glapiński (7 May): the probability of a hike has risen and a cut is very unlikely - a CPI breach of 3.5% with persistent forecasts would trigger action. Tyrowicz (20 May): 3.75% is too low; Glapiński (18 May): no commitments. April CPI 3.2% (final, 15 May; flash 30 Apr, 3.0% expected); core 3.0% (18 May). The fuel VAT and excise cuts were extended to 31 May (13 May).
policy.risk_text: Global bond rout (UST 10Y ~4.6-4.7%, Bund ~3.2%, gilts ~5.2%) and hike pricing up to ~100bp, while the MPC says hold until July and April activity disappoints (GDP 3.4%, wages, retail) - the long end follows core markets.

macro.projection_text: NBP March projection (4 Mar; data to 19 Feb, war excluded): CPI 50% bands 1.6-2.9% (2026), 1.1-3.7% (2027); central path 2.3% / 2.4% / 2.3% (2026-28), GDP 3.9% in 2026; IMF (14 Apr): 2026 CPI 3.3%. The July projection is the next marker.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit 7.3% of GDP (GUS EDP, 22 Apr), debt 59.7%; 2026 deficit cap PLN 271.7bn; budget deficit after April PLN 89.3bn (30.1% of the limit); the fiscal notification and the government's assumptions put the 2026 deficit at ~6.8% of GDP; the SAFE loan was signed on 8 May; windfall-tax bill due in Q2 (75% of margins above the 2025 level +20%); fuel package (VAT 8%, minimum excise, price caps) extended to 31 May (13 May).
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~51% (after 13 May, Millennium) financed; budget accounts ~PLN 184bn at end-April (MoF estimate); 8 May T-bill PLN 3.66bn at 4.151%. S&P affirmed A-/stable (8 May); Scope moved its A outlook to negative (15 May); Fitch A- and Moody's A2 have negative outlooks.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP held at 3.75% on 6 May; April CPI 3.2% y/y; Q1 GDP 3.4% y/y (flash). Ratings: Fitch A- negative, Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable (affirmed 8 May). 20 May: the WZ coupon for 25 May-25 Nov was set at 3.96% (WIBOR 6M 3.97/3.96/3.96); MoF mandated BNP and UBS for a CHF issue; Tyrowicz: 3.75% is too low; consumer confidence improved and GUS inflation expectations eased; HICP 3.4%; State Treasury debt PLN 2,088.8bn; POLGB yields fell 11-12bp as oil dipped (DS0436 5.93%); ING: the smaller offer helps. Abroad: Trump said Iran talks are in the 'final stage' and Brent fell 5.6% to $105; UST 10Y 4.58%, Bund 3.10%, gilt -14bp; UK April CPI 2.8% undershot; euro-area HICP 3.0% confirmed; hawkish FOMC minutes (many wanted the easing bias dropped).

calendar.plan_text: MoF May plan (30 Apr): sale auctions on 13 May (PLN 6-12bn), 21 May (7-13bn) and 27 May (6-12bn) in OK0129 (new 2Y, replaces OK0128), NZ0331, PS0731, DS0436 and NZ0936; a 46-week T-bill on 8 May (3-6bn); no switch. ~49% of 2026 needs financed after the April sales. 8 May T-bill: PLN 3.66bn at 4.151% plus 0.55bn. 13 May sale: PLN 11.01bn vs 13.73bn demand (cover 1.25) plus 0.85bn; OK0129 4.868%, PS0731 5.360%, DS0436 5.854%, PS0130 5.018%. 21 May offer (19 May): PLN 6-10bn, cut from 7-13bn in the plan (DS1034 added). BGK FPC (14 May): PLN 0.84bn on 1.10bn demand plus 0.15bn.
calendar.timing_text: The Aug 2025-Feb 2026 pattern (auction-day close the cheapest point of the week) comes from a rally regime; March's sell-off broke it and April's auction days cheapened on average. Remaining May sales: 21 May, 27 May. Next MPC 1-2 Jun: a hold is expected; the July projection is the next marker. Covers: 1.25 (13 May) vs 1.13-1.25 in April.

facts.core_text: Regime: talks in a 'final stage' - oil off its highs, core yields retreating; the NBP held at 3.75% on 6 May while FRAs price roughly 85bp of NBP hikes; the ECB is priced for a June hike, the BoE for hikes, the Fed has turned to hike risk, the CNB and MNB are on hold. Poland's 5Y CDS was 52bp and the 10Y spread to Bunds 285bp on benchmark bonds (Erste, 20 May close). Hawkish Fed minutes; Brent -5.6% (20 May).

quasi_takeaways: FPC fixed lines trade ~{lo}-{hi}bp over the POLGB curve (average {avg}bp); widest ASW {widest} at {widest_asw}bp. Same State Treasury guarantee as POLGBs.
Best pickup: {best} ({best_sp}bp vs POLGB). For buy-and-hold books the guarantee makes the pickup attractive; liquidity is the cost (Pekao became BGK market maker on 13 Nov 2025).
Supply: BGK sold PLN 0.84bn on 14 May plus 0.15bn; it filed a EUR 35bn MTN prospectus (19 May); next FPC tender 28 May.
Use auctions, not Catalyst: trades are small retail lots and some lines go weeks without a print.
